title: AGENT_PROFILE
description: A versioned agent, treated as a product rather than a prompt. The scoring and promotion machinery needs production traffic and is deliberately not built - but recording the shape now means the data exists in the right form when there is traffic, which is the part that cannot be retrofitted.

identity.description: Workload identity this runs as, SPIFFE-format.

model.description: Selection policy, not a fixed name - the cheapest model that meets the required confidence.

deniedTools.description: What this seat may never do. The grant, not the approval.

memoryPolicy.description: Whether it may write to the memory store. Most seats should not.

evaluations.description: Empty until there is traffic to evaluate against. Stated as empty rather than omitted, so the gap is visible.

judgeAgreement.description: How often the automated judge agreed with a human on the same items. An uncalibrated judge is an opinion with a number attached.

limitations.description: What it is known to be bad at. An empty list means nobody looked.

rollbackTo.description: The version to fall back to. Required: a version with no way back is not deployable.
